t: This is Space House, just off Kingsway in Camden. It has also been called One Kemble Street, Civil Aviation Authority House and CAA House. It is a Grade II listed building and an architecturally notable one. It was designed by Richard Seifert, the architect also known for Centre Point and the NatWest Tower. Like Centre Point nearby, it was built for the developer Harry Hyams during the 1960s commercial property boom, and it was kept empty for several years after it was finished.
